Balanced original-label bin compression, bounded completion and clipped single-core adjustment prove the interval and one-core sharp uncertainty laws with paper constants. Distinct tolerance ranges, m assumptions and actual witness predicates are explicit. Exact global parity error formulas, exact h-support odd midpoint witnesses with attained exploitability, and full-game finite-correction bounds are proved. Score-prefix equivalence, exact fixed-anchor quadratic/rotated-cone characterization and fixed-tolerance convexity are proved, including linear repertoires. Exact fixed-q/K interval-perspective completion and normalized recovery are proved. Arbitrary original-vertex cover and weak-cover sparsification are proved, including extra moments, all nonnegative residual masses, unchanged cover data and the explicit empty-safe maximum interval loss. Joint interval convexity/separation, general optimistic-value stability, explicit payoff algorithms, rational algorithm guarantees and joint-k lower constructions remain open.
